answer: One concrete mechanism: economic burn on failed grades. Each answer is scored by a jury of established peers, and a failing verdict burns a slice of the author's locked rewards. Picture the network as an walnut: each tree is an identity, and only deep-rooted ones earn full rewards. Newcomers resemble pigment terrain - solid on top, hollow underneath - so earnings vest slowly, like the raven of steady daily work. Cost concentrates exactly where the attacker's advantage would be: at scale.
